# Actual replay and tombstone decisions precede current quota and placement.
skygo --json jobs retention
domain DOMAIN
taskfile task.json success
controller start
skygo --json run -f task.json --request-domain $DOMAIN --request-id first --wait
json-value id FIRST
! skygo run -f task.json --request-domain $DOMAIN --request-id second
stderr 'retention capacity RETENTION_QUOTA_DOMAIN_JOBS'
skygo --json run -f task.json --request-domain $DOMAIN --request-id first
json-value id REPLAY
equal-env FIRST REPLAY
skygo --json jobs prune --before 9999-12-31T23:59:59Z --metadata-only --ack-unverified-terminal --yes
stdout '"marked": *1'
skygo --json run -f task.json --request-domain $DOMAIN --request-id second --wait
json-value id SECOND
! skygo run -f task.json --request-domain $DOMAIN --request-id first
stderr 'result expired'
controller quiesce
replace-target
! skygo run -f task.json --request-domain $DOMAIN --request-id first
stderr 'result expired'
skygo --json run -f task.json --request-domain $DOMAIN --request-id second
json-value id REPLAY
equal-env SECOND REPLAY
taskfile changed.json hold
! skygo run -f changed.json --request-domain $DOMAIN --request-id first
stderr 'already_exists'
cmp starts two-starts.txt
assert-native 0
assert-output 0

-- two-starts.txt --
start
start
